scope: Formal 150-step rank-16 attention LoRA training on the isolated DROID train split
summary: A single continuous four-GPU training run completed all 150 optimizer steps over 172 native multiview videos and produced an audited adapter-only checkpoint.
evidence: The effective framework config records 45 input frames, state_t=12, CP4/FSDP4, rank 16, attention-only Q/K/V/output targets, 150 iterations, and the 172-sample train split.
All 150 steps completed with finite logged losses and the distributed launcher returned code 0.
The checkpoint contains 576 tensors and 42,467,328 values; every key is net-prefixed and every tensor is a lora_A or lora_B parameter.
The training dataloader points only to composite-v6-native16-2clips/train; validation and final-holdout continuations were not read by training.
lessons: The 45-frame CP4 curriculum and bounded allocator configuration remain stable across a complete 150-step stage on shared A800 GPUs.
limitations: Training completion does not establish video-quality improvement; the checkpoint still requires generation and strict validation evaluation.
This stage saves only at step 150, so it cannot by itself compare earlier checkpoints.
next_actions: Generate both isolated validation episodes with pinned T5 embeddings and evaluate continuation frames per view against the public-base reference and strict gates.
